title: Compactified direct-image towers, reduction and composition
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/(\varpi^n)$ for $n\ge1$. Use the operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. All schemes below are separated of finite type over $k$ and all morphisms are separated of finite type. At $A_n$ write $\mathcal C_{T,A_n}=D^b_{ctf}(T,A_n)$, the bounded constructible finite-Tor category; at $R,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ write $\mathcal C_{T,\Lambda}=D^b_c(T,\Lambda)$. Integral categories use completed coefficient sheaves and derived completeness with reductions in one finite cohomological interval independent of $n$; field categories use rationalization and common finite coefficient-field stages, respectively. 

Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ and choose compactifications $c=(j,\bar f)$, where $j$ is quasi-compact open, $\bar f$ proper and $f=\bar f j$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Write $F_f^c=R\bar f_*j_!$, with integral and field realizations exactly as in [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. On the finite bounded-below etale-origin domain (a chosen pullback from the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]), the canonical refinement maps between the $F_f^c$ are isomorphisms, independent of a common refinement, with identity and transitivity cocycles. Bounded constructible finite inputs admit these witnesses. These same normalized comparisons hold on integral constructible inputs with compatible finite-reduction witnesses and on their specified lattice and common-stage field presentations; they respect reduction and coefficient passage.
For $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$ put $K_n=K\otimes_R^L A_n$. The canonical reduction maps are isomorphisms
$$(Rf_*K)\otimes_R^L A_n\simeq Rf_{*,n}K_n,\qquad (Rf_!K)\otimes_R^L A_n\simeq Rf_{!,n}K_n.$$
For $A_n\to A_m$ both direct-image comparisons are isomorphisms on $\mathcal C_{X,A_n}$. For a coherent normalized DVR tower $(M_n)$ on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ of [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], the actual counit gives $(R\varprojlim\operatorname{Res}_nM_n)\otimes_R^L A_m\simeq M_m$; if its terms are constructible in one common finite cohomological interval, its limit is in $D^b_c(Y,R)$.
The canonical composition maps give $R(gf)_!\simeq Rg_!Rf_!$, satisfy identity and associativity, and agree with the specified completed and field composition maps. For proper $f$, the compactification with identity open factor gives the canonical identification $Rf_!\simeq Rf_*$, and under it the compact-support exchange $\operatorname{Ex}_!$ of [def-exchange-projection] is the proper base-change exchange $\operatorname{Ex}_*$. At the integral stage it identifies the strict quotient-transition tower defining compact support with the strict tower defining ordinary direct image, including transitions, and hence identifies their derived limits. Rational and common-stage passage carry that identification to the field stages.
